rationale: manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-1 onboarding: Manduca 2009 proj-space bilateral w/ CT noise model (N0*exp(-P)->sqrt->bilateral->invert) trainable on DD-BF; paper-faithful defaults.

manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=six-box: (a) iter-1 hr=0.0598 ssim=0.9243 (positive-headroom) at paper-faithful defaults proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=1.5, bf_d_w_ratio=1/6, manduca_N0=1e5, img_n_bf=1, ep=10, ~387s. (b) Limiter: under-smoothing in the projection (Q=sqrt(N0*exp(-P))) domain. With N0=1e5, Q in [0,~316] and the sqrt/Anscombe noise std ~0.5 sqrt-counts; proj_sr=1.5 only averages pixels within +/-1.5 sqrt-counts so the dominant mid-Q soft-tissue noise (where Mayo SSIM is gated) survives into the FBP. Tiny capacity (~7 params) means the range bandwidth IS the denoising strength. (c) Lever: proj_sr 1.5 -> 3.0 (one knob) widens the range kernel to ~6 noise-sigma so the proj-bilateral averages more surviving soft-tissue noise, raising calibrated-SSIM-headroom. (d) No capacity/epoch change -> same ~387s wall, well inside 20-min budget. (e) BASE_ITER=1., proj_sr=3.0

manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=six-box manduca_bilateral iter-3 (EXPLORATORY). (a) PRIOR: iter-1 (proj_sr=1.5) hr=0.05982; iter-2 (proj_sr=3.0) hr=0.05978 -> proj_sr FLAT (range bandwidth NOT the binding constraint over 1.5-3.0). (b) FAILURE MODE: the proj-bilateral spatial footprint is sub-pixel. With proj_w=5 and bf_d_w_ratio=1/6, proj spatial sigma = (1/6)*5 = 0.83 px < 1 px, so the kernel averages essentially only the center detector sample. No matter how wide the RANGE kernel (proj_sr) is opened, there are no spatial neighbors being pooled, so soft-tissue noise survives into the FBP and hr is pinned. The range bandwidth can only bite once the spatial reach covers real neighbors. (c) LEVER (one knob): bf_d_w_ratio 1/6(=0.167) -> 0.5, raising proj spatial sigma 0.83px -> 2.5px (a genuine ~5-tap pooling footprint), which finally lets the already-wide range kernel average surviving mid-Q soft-tissue noise -> higher calibrated-SSIM-headroom. This is the paper-locked d/w degree of freedom, the highest-impact lever given the tiny (~7-param) capacity where kernel geometry IS the denoising strength. (d) BUDGET: no capacity/epoch change -> ~387-557s wall as in iter-1/2, well inside the 20-min budget. (e) BASE_ITER=1 (hr-best; iter-2 is tied within noise)., bf_d_w_ratio=0.5

manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=six-box manduca_bilateral iter-4 (EXPLORATORY). (a) PRIOR FLAT: iter-1 (proj_sr=1.5) hr=0.05982; iter-2 (proj_sr=3.0) hr=0.05978; iter-3 (bf_d_w_ratio 1/6->0.5 i.e. proj spatial sigma 0.83px->2.5px, AND proj range wide) hr=0.05983. So EVERY proj-domain bilateral lever (range bandwidth proj_sr, spatial footprint bf_d_w_ratio) is FLAT to <1e-4. (b) FAILURE MODE / WHY PROJ-BILATERAL IS FLAT: the truncation-corrected FBP is already a strong reconstruction; the ~7-param proj-domain bilateral acts on the SINOGRAM before backprojection, where its tiny correction is smeared across all detector channels and largely washed out by the ramp filter + backprojection averaging, contributing almost nothing to the final image-domain SSIM/headroom. The binding constraint is NOT projection-domain noise bandwidth - it is that no operator is yet touching the reconstructed IMAGE where SSIM/hr are actually measured (img_n_bf=1 is a single shallow image-bilateral pass). (c) LEVER (one knob): img_n_bf 1->2, stacking a second image-domain trainable bilateral filter directly on the reconstructed image. This is a genuinely DIFFERENT axis from the 3 flat proj-domain iters: it doubles the image-domain denoising capacity at the exact location where the calibrated-SSIM-headroom metric lives, so surviving soft-tissue noise in the FBP output gets a second edge-preserving smoothing pass - the most direct route to move SSIM/hr. (d) BUDGET: +1 image-bilateral filter is ~7 extra params and one extra cheap conv per forward pass -> wall stays ~387-563s as iter-1/2/3, comfortably inside the hard 20-min budget. (e) BASE_ITER=3 (hr-best @ 0.05983, marginally best; preserves the iter-3 proj spatial-sigma=2.5px state and layers the image-domain capacity on top)., bf_d_w_ratio=0.5, img_n_bf=2
